title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist discovers time travel via microwave, unraveling a conspiracy spanning timelines. The divergence meter ticks between worldlines as Okabe Rintaro fights to save what matters.
notes: All-time favorite. The Divergence Meter in the showroom is a Steins;Gate reference. El Psy Kongroo.

title: Code Geass
synopsis: Lelouch vi Britannia gains the power of absolute obedience and wages a one-man war against the empire that destroyed his family. Chess, mecha, and the question of whether the ends justify the means.
notes: Lelouch is the best anti-hero in anime. The finale is perfect.

title: Death Note
synopsis: Light Yagami finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. A god complex, a genius detective, and a cat-and-mouse game that redefined the psychological thriller genre.
notes: The first half is unbeatable. L vs Light is iconic.

title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity fights for survival behind walls that protect them from man-eating Titans. A story about freedom, war, and the cycle of violence that escalates far beyond where it starts.
notes: The story evolution across seasons is masterful. The reveal changes everything.

title: Chaos;Head
synopsis: A hikikomori gets caught in a series of murders linked to delusional powers. Part of the Science Adventure series alongside Steins;Gate, though the VN is much better than the anime.
notes: The visual novel is the proper way to experience this. The Science Adventure universe is great.

title: Steins;Gate 0
synopsis: The beta worldline story — what happened to Okabe in the timeline where he gave up. A darker, more philosophical companion to the original that makes the ending of Steins;Gate possible.
notes: Makes the original ending more meaningful. Maho is a great character.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: A young Viking named Thorfinn seeks revenge in a story that evolves into a profound meditation on violence, peace, and what it means to be a true warrior.
notes: S2 transforms from revenge story to something much deeper.
